meta.objective: Identify any remaining patches after the validated full V3 completion, define the scaffolding needed for repeatable sanity reruns, and decide whether to relaunch a new sanity run immediately.

decisions: Use the validated full V3 completion as the baseline evidence bundle.
Prefer no new patch unless the repeatability audit finds a concrete blocker.
If the relaunch gate stays green, execute one new sanity rerun in this workflow.
The executed sanity rerun passed the old score-stage failure boundary without reproducing the timeout family.
